meta.title: Enhance multi-agent swarm structures
meta.body_summary: Enhances HierarchicalSwarm with reliability, concurrency, and observability features for production multi-agent task execution.

perf_labels.notes: Large-scope multi-agent swarm refactor; bot reviews flagged load-balancing bug, unsafe assignment, argument misuse, and type errors; PR closed without merge due to unresolved functional issues.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 4691 changed lines across 6 files (including large documentation), this is a large-scale refactor by absolute volume. As a major feature/enhancement performance PR, it was closed without merge after multiple bot-flagged bugs and no human approval.

review_details.concern_detail: Cursor bot review identified three specific bugs: load balancing non-functional because running_tasks dict is never populated, unsafe agent.__dict__ assignment in handle_teams bypasses normal attribute setting, and incorrect positional argument and missing img parameter in agent.run via ThreadPoolExecutor. GitHub Advanced Security scan additionally flagged type incompatibilities and an undefined pydantic import.
review_details.performance_claim: Concurrent task execution, intelligent load balancing, and priority scheduling improve multi-agent swarm performance.
review_details.rejection_signals: PR closed by maintainer after 25 days; bot reviews highlighted critical functional bugs that were not addressed.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Refactoring a large multi-agent swarm system with concurrency, load balancing, and task management introduced functional bugs in core logic, type errors, and unsafe patterns that Cursor did not resolve.

detection_detail.code_reading: Cursor bot performed static analysis and flagged specific code issues (load balancing, unsafe assignment, argument mismatch).
detection_detail.ci_auto: GitHub Advanced Security scan detected undefined import, incompatible types, inconsistent override, and more than 20 potential problems.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmark or profiling data; PR claims performance improvements without measurements or repro steps.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed by kyegomez with no fix commits; bot-flagged issues remained unresolved.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored HierarchicalSwarm in swarms/structs/hiearchical_swarm.py to add concurrency (ThreadPoolExecutor), load balancing, priority scheduling, agent health monitoring, task timeouts, and retries. Added large summarization markdown files and new communication modules (enhanced_communication.py, hierarchical_cooperation.py) and a new enhanced_hierarchical_swarm.py.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: The two .md files are documentation summaries with no functional code impact; they contribute to the large line count.
change_trajectory: Initial commit (6d73b8): modified hiearchical_swarm.py with concurrency, load balancing, monitoring, and added hierarchical_swarm_improvements.md.
Second commit (d59e2cc): added new communication modules and an enhanced hierarchical swarm variant, plus another summary markdown.

review_signals.summary: Load balancing is non-functional because the self.running_tasks dictionary is never populated.
handle_teams uses agent.__dict__['team_name'] assignment, bypassing normal attribute setting and potentially causing errors.
ThreadPoolExecutor.submit passes agent_context positionally and omits img parameter, risking runtime errors.
Multiple type incompatibility warnings (img declared as str but used as None, incompatible variable types, inconsistent override, undefined pydantic import).
Pyre found more than 20 potential problems in the proposed changes.
Dependency review found no vulnerabilities or license issues.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor authored two commits with large-scale refactoring; immediate automated reviews from Cursor bot and GitHub Advanced Security flagged functional bugs and type issues; no human reviewer engaged; PR remained open for 25 days without fix; maintainer kyegomez closed the PR.
